name: Auris
tagline: Tracks PTSD symptoms between therapy sessions with clinical scales and camera-based vitals.

awards: MLH || Best Use of Presage || Fitbit Inspire & Presage Perks

problem: Therapists cannot see physiological responses between sessions.
solution: An Android app pairs clinical questionnaires with contactless vitals from the camera, tags responses to triggers and builds embeddings for therapists.
demo_moment: Team-described: answer a scale while vitals are recorded.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Health & Wellness” and “MLH || Best Use of Presage || Fitbit Inspire & Presage Perks” among 231 submissions.

lessons: Show clinicians the moments they never see.
